t: In front of you, in Victoria Embankment Gardens, is a bronze statue of General Charles George Gordon, standing on a stone plinth. It's Grade II listed, and was made by the sculptor Hamo Thornycroft, who also made the Oliver Cromwell statue outside the Palace of Westminster. Gordon was a British army officer who fought in the Crimean War. He made his name in China, commanding the Ever Victorious Army against the Taiping Rebellion, which earned him the nickname Chinese Gordon. A similar statue stands in Melbourne, Australia.
